title: Product of padded parity inputs
statement: Let $n,m$ be natural numbers with $n\le m$, and let $x$ be a sign vector of length $n$. Extend it to length $m$ by using its original coordinates in the first $n$ positions and the sign $1$ thereafter. The product of the resulting $m$ signs equals the product of the coordinates of $x$.
hypotheses_covered: n and m are natural numbers
x is a sign vector of length n
